port_shape.composition: Integrator-approved: separate BudgetReadPort/BudgetWritePort, ProductionReadPort extends BudgetReadPort; ProductionWritePort extends ProductionReadPort,BudgetWritePort. Same B2 commit implements all mandatory methods on SQLite. No alternate store or extension infrastructure. Inventory found zero directly typed literal fake stores outside sqlite; existing shot-plan/revisions/runtime partial fakes are explicit casts and keep their existing test purpose.
support_types: InsertOutcome<T>={record:T,created:boolean}; identical natural-key payload replay false; differing semantic payload throws.
semantics: Append policy/auth revision and latest-head CAS in same tx; CAS false leaves zero writes (check prior state before insert or throw/rollback internally). Revision=prior+1 overflow checked; new revisionId distinct. Scope identity immutable.
Storage validates strict schemas before SQL; repeated immutable ID/natural key semantic equality returns original record. Never INSERT OR REPLACE/UPSERT existing history payload.

registerBudgetExecution verifies project exists and media execution matches existing job/project/idempotency/requestHash/operation. Text ID is supplied only by trusted server service and registered once; no fake job.

listBudgetLedger returns every relevant reservation across every policy/auth revision and all associated ordered events, without default LIMIT/truncation. Pure fold computes safe totals. Account_day uses original utcDay; project uses all days. No cached accounting projection needed in first local implementation.

insertBudgetQuote accepts binding:null for genuinely unknown quote/account facts; preserve query-visible immutable unknown BudgetQuote. Reserve always requires valid binding and complete known unit/currency/account/estimate facts. A later verified quote receives a new quote ID; do not rewrite unknown history or upgrade old quote silently.

tables.budget_policies: policy_id PK; provider/account/currency/unit stable columns; UNIQUE(provider_id,account_id,unit,currency_key), currency_key=COALESCE(currency,''); CHECK unit/currency pairing. Mutable head_revision only via CAS; never allow project-specific competing policy scope.
tables.budget_policy_revisions: revision_id PK; policy_id FK; revision positive-safe; UNIQUE(policy_id,revision); payload JSON; scope must match policy identity. Append-only.
tables.budget_authorizations: authorization_id PK; project_id FK projects; policy_id FK; UNIQUE(project_id,policy_id); mutable head_revision only CAS.
tables.budget_authorization_revisions: revision_id PK; authorization_id FK; policy_revision_at_authorization FK; revision; UNIQUE(auth_id,revision); payload; append-only. Latest stable policy revisions apply immediately; historic referenced revision is provenance, not authorization to ignore latest cap/revocation.
tables.budget_account_evidence: id PK; provider/account/credential_binding_id/observed_at/expires_at columns + strict payload; immutable. Index(provider_id,credential_binding_id,observed_at DESC,id). Lookup does not prove current connection; trusted current credential binding required by service.
tables.budget_quotes: id PK; project_id FK; optional media_quote_id UNIQUE with composite FK records(kind=quote,id); payload. Text permits null media quote. Unknown quote persists with currency/unit nullable per actual B1 schema and no binding row; null facts cannot create policy scope/reservation.
tables.budget_quote_bindings: budget_quote_id UNIQUE FK; id PK; account_evidence_id FK; account/scope/binding/semantic hashes projected. If available, insert quote+binding in same tx; absence is explicit unknown; matching scope/evidence enforced by validated adapter.
tables.budget_executions: execution_id PK; project_id FK; idempotency_key; kind; media_job_id nullable UNIQUE FK jobs; CHECK media_job needs media_job_id=execution_id, text needs NULL; UNIQUE(project_id,idempotency_key); immutable recipe payload/hash.
tables.budget_reservations: id PK; execution_id UNIQUE FK; project/idempotency UNIQUE; policy/auth revision IDs FK; quote/binding/evidence FKs; provider/account/currency/unit/utc_day/reserved_at/upper_estimate projected; immutable payload. Index(project_id,provider_id,account_id,unit,currency_key); Index(provider_id,account_id,unit,currency_key,utc_day).
tables.budget_reconciliation_events: sequence INTEGER PRIMARY KEY; reservation_id FK; provider/account/event_key; UNIQUE(provider_id,account_id,event_key); semantic_hash/payload; append-only. Index(reservation_id,sequence). Auto sequence allocated only new event; repeated key compares canonical evidence excluding ingest sequence, rejects conflict including changed reservation.
tables.constraints: Revision/count/amount integers constrained0..MAX_SAFE_INTEGER as appropriate; budget times constrained0..MAX_BUDGET_UTC_MILLIS; JSON schema validation remains mandatory. FKs ON DELETE RESTRICT; no cascade ledger deletion. Append-only SQL UPDATE/DELETE rejection triggers on history/evidence/executions/reservations/events; head tables only intended head CAS mutable.

B3_service_contract.route: GET query + POST strict discriminated policy/project authorization commands only. Same-origin bounded JSON/error helpers, injected service from existing runtime. No reconciliation/refund/actual/evidence mutation route. Actor denotes local human profile, not hosted auth.

algorithm: Open existing short store.transaction. Re-read current job; require queued/retry-eligible pre-submit state, exact immutable request and live owned lease; cancel_requested/unknown/submitting never grants new submission.

Re-read current quote and semantic/account binding; use current time/fresh capability and productionSubmissionEligibilityFingerprint(tx,...) exact expected value to preserve approvals/selected plan/canon.
Invoke synchronous B3 reserve callback using tx. Validate latest standing policy/auth/credential/evidence/scope/quote; fold complete account-day and project totals, reserve upper estimate.

Perform updateLeasedJob to submitting and append event inside SAME tx. Any false CAS/event failure throws, rolling back reservation. Return refreshed lease/current record. Provider network follows commit outside transaction.

Worker async account discovery happens before this boundary; no async boolean authorization and no reserve-now/submit-later transaction. Post-boundary shutdown ACK persistence/cancellation/unknown handling remains intact; accounting never releases just from status.

scope_truth: BudgetScope for policies/bindings/reservations must be known: explicit ISO money minor-unit or explicit supported token unit only when trusted provider evidence identifies that denomination. BudgetQuote may retain currency/unit=null unknown. Sogni entitlement spark does not prove a spark_token ledger unit or token-to-money conversion; configured credentials/catalog alone produce no account identity or known denomination. Reserve blocks unknown facts. Future token-unit support remains explicit evidence-backed extension, not fabricated Sogni facts.
